synopsis: Chapter 3 and the glossary report that China's Coal Mine Safety Regulations require underground trackless rubber-tired vehicles traveling in the same direction to maintain at least 50 m separation [f2298, f15591]. The cited source is a peer-reviewed article in Meikuang Anquan published in July 2023, rather than the regulation text itself [f2298, f2299]. Chapter 3 reports that the regulations are in force and cover underground trackless vehicle operation, but both findings rely on academic reporting without direct review of the regulatory text [f2810, f2811]. The 50 m requirement is consistently repeated across the supplied facts; the key gap is primary-source verification, not a conflicting distance [f2135, f2612, f2812, f15591, f2299].
